purpose: Explain cross-paper no-skill score differences without treating distinct protocols as a model-strength ranking.

original_declared_conditions.provided_solved_steps: No in official suite Table 5; authors' actual per-request records were not available for independent inspection.

actual_project_conditions.suite: custom source-isolated generator IID; not official Advanced
actual_project_conditions.solved_steps: AE allowable-jurisdiction result supplied to EC and EV; EC answer is not supplied to EV.

inference_limits: Differences demonstrate lack of direct score comparability; their individual causal contributions have not been isolated.
The saved baseline is an empty learned library, not an entirely unassisted raw benchmark prompt.
No evidence here establishes Qwen3-8B intrinsically stronger than the other models, nor establishes that every point of the cross-paper gap has been explained.
Closest-method quality comparison must use the same project cases, inputs, generation and scorer, as the currently authorized adaptation does.
